title: Analogue Paneer: What It Is, the Labelling Rules and How to Tell It From Real Paneer
seoTitle: Analogue Paneer: FSSAI Rules, State Bans and Real Tests
seoDescription: Analogue paneer swaps milk fat for vegetable fat or starch. See FSSAI's paneer standard, label rules, 2026 state bans and which home tests actually work.
excerpt: FSSAI's paneer standard in one table, the label wording analogues must carry, the 2026 state bans and the national draft, plus why the iodine test can't catch vegetable fat.
